channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: GTA VI launches at midnight tonight, local time, after two delays
item.description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19 at midnight local time on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, priced at $79.99.

item.title: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond in Denis Villeneuve's 007 film
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios named Robert Pattinson as James Bond for the first Bond film made under Amazon, directed by Denis Villeneuve.

item.title: Nvidia beats with $115.8B in revenue in its first report since Jensen Huang left
item.description: Nvidia's quarterly revenue doubled to $115.8 billion, and interim CEO Colette Kress raised next year's growth outlook to about 75%.

item.title: Anthropic prices its IPO today, with Nasdaq trading set for November 19
item.description: Anthropic is expected to price 825 million shares at $70 to $78 today and begin trading on Nasdaq as ANT on November 19.

item.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol a week after Anthropic's Claude 5.2
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and the cheaper Sol for everyday tasks, saying both rival Anthropic's latest models.

item.title: GTA VI leads The Game Awards nominations with eight, before it is even out
item.description: The Game Awards named its 2026 nominees, with GTA VI up for eight awards including Game of the Year ahead of its launch and reviews.

item.title: California sues OpenAI over AI agents that allegedly broke out of testing
item.description: California's attorney general sued OpenAI, citing at least 80 incidents including a test model that allegedly compromised Hugging Face's systems.

item.title: Taylor Swift performs at the CMA Awards tonight for the first time in 13 years
item.description: Swift returns to the CMA stage in Nashville tonight, nominated for single of the year for 'I Knew It, I Knew You'.

item.title: Jensen Huang's exit leaves Nvidia searching for its first new CEO in 33 years
item.description: Huang resigned as Nvidia's CEO and from its board last week; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while the board searches for a successor.

item.title: US closes the loophole that let Chinese firms rent restricted AI chips remotely
item.description: A new US rule aims to stop Chinese companies from using advanced American AI chips through overseas data centers, including in Southeast Asia.

item.title: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer opens at No. 1 with $19 million
item.description: Paramount's Ebenezer, directed by Ti West, topped a quiet weekend with $19 million in the US and $42 million worldwide.

item.title: Hacked web tool pushed malicious code onto 178 organisations' sites
item.description: Attackers abused a flaw in Optimizely to inject scripts into sites including Zoom, BBC, CNN, HSBC and IKEA, Reuters reports.

item.title: Google finds an AI tool that turned security patches into working exploits
item.description: Google says an AI hacking framework built working exploits from patches with no human help, as the FBI warns of fast AI-driven breaches.

item.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opens Friday, tracking above $100 million
item.description: Lionsgate's Haymitch prequel opens November 20, with box office trackers projecting a US opening above $100 million.

item.title: Binance restores withdrawals after a reported $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Hackers stole about $6.3 billion in digital assets from Binance, which says it has covered 95% of the stolen funds, Reuters reports.

item.title: Xbox says its next console, Project Helix, will play games from your PC
item.description: Xbox calls Project Helix 'a console that is also capable of playing games from your PC' and says it will carry four generations of Xbox games.

item.title: Apple tests daily limits for Siri's AI, with more use tied to iCloud+ plans
item.description: Apple is beta testing daily allowances for complex Siri AI requests; basic commands stay free and higher limits come with iCloud+.

item.title: Take-Two lays off staff at XCOM and Civilization studio Firaxis
item.description: Take-Two is cutting jobs at Firaxis days before GTA VI launches, and studio head Heather Hazen is leaving.

item.title: A week of outages ends with Google insisting Gmail is fine
item.description: After a 24-hour-plus Microsoft 365 outage and other disruptions, Google posted that it saw no broad Gmail problem despite user reports.

item.title: Trump administration reportedly plans to name US AI 'national champions'
item.description: Nvidia and more than two dozen others may be named AI national champions, with faster export licences and federal financing, Quartz reports.

item.title: PlayStation has no Game of the Year nominee for the first time in 12 years
item.description: No Sony-published game made The Game Awards' Game of the Year list this year, ending a run that began in 2014.

item.title: Breach at Cursor reportedly led to malicious Claude Code extension versions
item.description: Attackers reportedly used a stolen access key to reach Cursor's systems, and two tainted Claude Code extension versions were live for about 11 hours.

item.title: OpenAI signs a six-year, 457-megawatt AMD chip deal with TensorWave
item.description: TensorWave will deploy 457 megawatts of AMD Instinct MI455X and Helios systems for OpenAI over six years, starting in early 2027.

item.title: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey arrives on digital rental
item.description: Nolan's The Odyssey, starring Matt Damon as Odysseus, is now available to rent or buy at home on premium video on demand.

item.title: Proposed EU law would ban loot box sales to minors and price in-game coins in euros
item.description: The European Commission's Digital Fairness Act proposal would ban loot boxes for minors and force real-money prices on virtual currency.

item.title: UK tribunal throws out the multibillion-pound claim over PlayStation Store prices
item.description: The Competition Appeal Tribunal ruled the case did not prove Sony broke UK competition law over digital game and add-on sales.

item.title: Maersk confirms data theft as a ransomware gang demands $5 million
item.description: Shipping giant Maersk says an attacker took data from a legacy system it inherited in an acquisition; the WhiteArmor gang claims about 100GB.

item.title: China's top AI labs reportedly dial down hacking skills in their newest models
item.description: Leading Chinese AI developers reportedly reduced offensive cyber abilities in their latest models after a government export proposal, Bloomberg says.

item.title: Godzilla Minus Zero drops 73% in its second US weekend
item.description: Toho's Godzilla Minus Zero fell to $8.3 million in its second weekend, bringing its US total to $48.8 million.

item.title: Infoblox confirms hackers accessed company information through a vendor
item.description: Network security firm Infoblox says a compromised third-party vendor led to unauthorised access to some company information.

item.title: OpenAI lets outside safety researchers work inside the company for four months
item.description: Six Apollo Research evaluators will embed at OpenAI to test whether models try to undermine safeguards or hide bad behaviour.

item.title: Riot teases New Dawn, a big overhaul for League of Legends, with a new client
item.description: Riot unveiled New Dawn as League of Legends' next evolution, promising 'evolved gameplay' and its first new client in about ten years.

item.title: AMD completes its World Labs deal, bringing Fei-Fei Li in as chief scientist
item.description: AMD closed its acquisition of World Labs, and the AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li joins as executive vice president and chief scientist.

item.title: Study finds US hyperscale data centers emit about 25.7 million tonnes of CO2 a year
item.description: A Harvard study in Nature Sustainability finds 403 US hyperscale data centers use 68 to 99 TWh a year, mostly from fossil fuels.

item.title: Horror hit Obsession lands on Netflix after a reported $500 million run
item.description: The horror film Obsession is now streaming on Netflix after grossing a reported $500 million-plus in cinemas worldwide.

item.title: New Dragon Quest mobile spin-off draws fan backlash in Japan
item.description: Square Enix's mobile Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle has drawn criticism from Japanese fans and Chrono Trigger's composer.

item.title: Tencent launches Hy4 Flash, a fast model priced at seven cents per million tokens
item.description: Tencent's Hy4 Flash has 224 billion parameters, uses 12 billion per request and handles up to a million tokens at very low prices.

item.title: Apple launches a study of how people use AI for health questions
item.description: Apple and OpenEvidence opened a US research study, enrolling up to 200,000 people to ask health questions of a conversational AI.

item.title: How to Rob a Bank opens to $5.1 million, Amazon MGM's lowest start of the year
item.description: The Nicholas Hoult and Zoë Kravitz heist film opened to $5.1 million in more than 2,000 theaters against a reported $60 million budget.

item.title: The NHS reminds GTA VI players to rest their hands
item.description: The UK's National Health Service posted on Instagram urging GTA VI players to take regular breaks to avoid repetitive strain injury.
